profileName: Enterprise Group Landscape and Scope View

cases.input: A 55%-owned company is present in ownership but excluded from accounting consolidation.
cases.expect: The ownership and consolidation graphs preserve different memberships without conflict.

cases.input: An ultimate owner cannot be determined at the requested knowledge horizon.
cases.expect: The view emits a typed unknown with evidence and review metadata rather than null or zero.

cases.input: Franchisees share a brand and participation network while remaining separate fact owners.
cases.expect: Only brand and participation edges appear; control is not inferred and access remains grant-driven.

cases.input: A view requests world time T1 and knowledge time T2 with pinned source revisions.
cases.expect: The immutable output records both horizons, graph rules, inputs and digest.

cases.input: A parent reads subsidiary facts solely because both appear in one group landscape.
cases.expect: The read is rejected without a valid access grant and governed disclosure shape.

cases.input: A shared trademark is used to infer legal control and consolidation.
A generated Group Scope View is written back as authoritative organization or relationship facts.
cases.expect: The write is rejected because the projection has no source-master write path.

cases.input: Two generators use identical pins, grant set, disclosure shape and projected content.
cases.expect: They produce the same digest and neither result is updated in place.

cases.input: Two views use the same landscape pins but different grant sets or disclosure shapes.
cases.expect: They produce distinct digests and each included cross-organization fact is authorized and shaped.

cases.input: Pinned graph rules exclude an unverified franchise edge.
cases.expect: The exclusion rule is visible in the pins; the source assertion remains unchanged.

cases.input: A ledger or contract uses the landscape profile name as its party key.
cases.expect: The reference is rejected because the profile name is only an operator label.

cases.input: A pre-incorporation steering body with delegated rights is modelled as a landscape because it has no registration yet.
cases.expect: The body is instantiated as WM-ORG-001 if it has independent standing; the landscape remains a profile.

cases.input: The same source and authorization pins are projected under a new composition engine revision.
cases.expect: The new engine revision is pinned and the changed projection receives a new digest.

cases.input: A view cites an immutable grant revision that was later revoked.
cases.expect: The historical revision remains resolvable for digest verification while current access is denied.

cases.input: A view emits a non-public subsidiary membership edge without an authorized disclosure basis or shape.
cases.expect: The edge is excluded or the view is rejected; membership itself is not authorization.

cases.input: A business object uses a landscape revision or view digest as its party or identity-bearing foreign key.
cases.expect: The reference is rejected; only evidence citation is allowed.
